levels.name: Grand Expectation
levels.description: Fantastic Voyage's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.

levels.name: Impasse Conqueror
levels.description: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.

levels.name: Unstoppable Fervor
levels.description: Increases the Level of Passion Overload by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Unexpected Odyssey
levels.description: Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of Passion Overload's. Charge Level 1 will perform a follow-up attack. This additional attack does 135% of the second attack's DMG.

levels.name: True Explorer
levels.description: Increases the Level of Fantastic Voyage by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Fire Ventures With Me
levels.description: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside Fantastic Voyage's radius gain a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their weapons are infused with Pyro.
